title: The Calendar Decision: Should a CFO Elect Semiannual Reporting?
subtitle: SEC File No. S7-2026-15, a 97 percent comment-file revolt, and the board posture that will not wait
description: An HBS-style case set on 1 September 2026. After the SEC proposed letting U.S. public companies replace Form 10-Q with a semiannual Form 10-S, and after a historically lopsided comment file closed 97 percent opposed, a mid-cap industrial CFO must recommend whether her board should pre-commit to quarterly reporting, prepare to elect, wait for a first cohort, or set a liquidity trigger. Real Commission statements, comment statistics, and CFA survey findings are woven through a teaching composite so students decide.
